query: select jsonb_build_object('captured_at',clock_timestamp(),'functions',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',p.proname,'arguments',pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'definition_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex')) order by n.nspname,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname||'.'||p.proname in ('private.apply_lead_opt_out','private.assign_lead_to_seller_with_reason','private.crm_transition_allowed','private.sync_protocol_next_action','public.assign_lead_to_seller','public.complete_contact_task','public.complete_contact_task_with_follow_up','public.reassign_leads_to_seller','public.record_contact_answer_with_transition','public.record_contact_task_result','public.record_lead_follow_up','public.refresh_due_contact_protocols'))) as snapshot;

functions.name: assign_lead_to_seller_with_reason
functions.arguments: p_lead_id uuid, p_seller_user_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_reason text
